model_annotation: This line plot compares the performance of five different models—StrmLLM (n=64), SepLLM (n=64), SepLLM (n=64, H), SepLLM (n=64, H/T), and SepLLM (n=128)—across a range of x-axis values, with the y-axis representing performance metrics. The x-axis is labeled “x” and uses a linear scale ranging from approximately 0 to 10, with tick marks at regular intervals of 1. The y-axis is labeled “y” and also uses a linear scale, ranging from approximately 0 to 100, with tick marks at regular intervals of 20. The blue line, representing StrmLLM (n=64), starts at a y-value of approximately 100 and decreases sharply to a final value of around 30. The orange line, SepLLM (n=64), begins at a y-value of approximately 95 and declines to around 25. The green line, SepLLM (n=64, H), starts at approximately 90 and ends at around 20. The red line, SepLLM (n=64, H/T), begins at approximately 85 and concludes at about 15. The purple line, SepLLM (n=128), starts at approximately 95 and ends at around 20. All lines exhibit a downward trend as the x-value increases, with the StrmLLM (n=64) line consistently above the others throughout the range.
